tools.name: king_county_permit_status
tools.description: Look up building permit history and status for any King County, WA property. Accepts a street address, 10-digit parcel number, or permit number. Searches MyBuildingPermit.com (14 cities + King County), Bellevue and Seattle Open Data, Renton EnerGov (live API), and WA State L&I (electrical permits).
